name: The Peninsula London
insider_take: The Peninsula London brings legendary Asian hospitality to Belgravia's elegant corner, where Rolls-Royce fleet service meets quintessential British sophistication.
whats_special: This is Peninsula's first European property, featuring their signature Rolls-Royce fleet in British Racing Green. The hotel sits in prestigious Belgravia, just steps from Hyde Park Corner and Buckingham Palace. Their rooftop restaurant offers stunning views of Wellington Arch and the Royal Parks, while the spa features the brand's first ESPA partnership in Europe.
pro_tip: Book afternoon tea on the rooftop terrace during sunset – you'll have unobstructed views of the palace and parks while enjoying Peninsula's legendary white-glove service.
dont_miss: The ground-floor Canton Blue restaurant serves authentic Cantonese cuisine in an elegant setting, while Harvey Nichols and Harrods are within walking distance. The hotel's location offers direct access to Green Park and Constitution Hill – perfect for royal watching during ceremonial events.
pros: Prime Belgravia location near Hyde Park Corner
Exceptional Peninsula hospitality and white-glove service
Newly opened luxury property with contemporary design
Access to Peninsula Pen Club loyalty benefits
cons: Limited availability due to high demand as newest Peninsula property
